findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body: When a user's tenant differs from the document's tenant, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` and permits cross-tenant document disclosure. The previous implementation enforced equality between `userTenant` and `documentTenant`.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, a user can read another tenant’s documents, breaking the access-control boundary.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document authorization
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from the target `documentTenant` will be granted read access, enabling cross-tenant document disclosure wherever this exported authorization check is used.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
